text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah, amazing...!
You're really good at this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So many...! They'd look
so cute all lined up together.
choice_data_list: Then I'll give them all to you as a present, Dantsu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-But...
I thought you wanted it, Trainer.
choice_data_list: You looked so captivated by it, so I thought you might want it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I've had my eye on Paka Petit for a while now.
I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I'll cherish eve~ry single one!
